record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. The point of the view is to read the specification and design where the work is tracked; an outline would send every real read to the pager.

## Counter-argument

In a 40% side pane full Markdown wraps into long scrolls, and an outline would fit the glance the dashboard is for.

payload.alternatives: an outline of section titles and one line per item, with the pager for full text
payload.choice: Spec and Design tabs show the full record text as Markdown; each requirement is a selectable row that opens its requirement detail

record.subject: spec-full-text
